requirement.description: View class doesn't properly handle Signal objects with layouts as targets. The current implementation incorrectly raises TypeError when a Signal with a valid layout is passed as a target, instead of correctly recognizing it as a valid data view.
requirement.contract: When a Signal with a layout is passed as the target to View.__init__, it should be recognized as a valid data view if the layout sizes match. The view should be constructed using the Signal's layout rather than raising a TypeError.

requirement.description: View.__getitem__ method doesn't properly validate array layout indexing. It raises incorrect error messages when trying to index array layouts with non-value objects.
requirement.contract: When indexing an ArrayLayout with a non-value object, the error message should be consistent with the expected format: "Only views with array layout, not {layout_type}, may be indexed with a value".

requirement.description: View.__getattr__ method doesn't properly handle missing field errors with proper error message formatting. It raises AttributeError with incomplete or incorrect suggestions.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via attribute access, the error message should include a proper suggestion of similar field names using difflib.get_close_matches for better UX.

requirement.description: Enum.const method doesn't properly handle enum values that are not directly castable. The method should accept both integer values and enum members.
requirement.contract: When calling Enum.const() with an enum member (e.g., EnumA.A), it should extract the member's value and cast it to the appropriate constant, rather than raising TypeError.

requirement.description: Signal constructor doesn't properly validate reset values for enums without explicit shapes. It should raise a TypeError with a specific message when reset values are not constant-castable.
requirement.contract: When constructing a Signal with an enum that has no explicit shape and a reset value that's not a constant-castable expression, it should raise a TypeError with the message "Reset value must be a constant initializer of <enum name>$".
